issues.on_page: 5200 Transfers from General Fund 27,521; Total Cash Receipts 27,521
issues.issue: Treated differently from the identical 5200 transfer lines in Depreciation (detail[59]) and School Nutrition (detail[72]), which are section 'revenue'. This line has no category or detail_category, and the printed Employee Benefit Total Cash Receipts 27,521 (p8) is missing from detail_totals.

Interfund transfers are counted twice in detail: 8000 Transfers 75,000 (expense) also shows up as Nutrition revenue (detail[72]); 2640 Care and Upkeep 100,000 (detail[47]) is the transfer to Depreciation (detail[59]) and is spent again there; 1100 Regular Instruction 4,470,303 (detail[27]) includes 27,521 that Employee Benefit spends again. p4 reclassifies all of these (202,521 in total). Already flagged with review; noted so the user knows detail spending is 202,521 higher than the statements.

All four Depreciation Fund disbursements (detail[60]-[63], 217,008 total) are tagged capital outlay, but p4 reports this fund's spending under 'Support Services - Other'. General Supplies 39,402 is especially doubtful as capital outlay.
Scoreboard Partnership (and possibly Hall of Fame 7,679, detail[133]) looks like sponsorship/donations, so donations/contributions may fit better.
